* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “May be battled. If with Dash Rendar, adds one destiny to attrition only. Once per turn, if at a battleground, you may peek at top card of opponent’s Reserve Deck; may place that card on top of opponent’s Used Pile.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[LE-BO2D9 (Leebo) (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “peek at top card” to “peek at the top card”. PC-E1 text: “May be battled. If with Dash Rendar, adds one destiny to attrition only. Once per turn, if at a battleground, you may peek at the top card of opponent's Reserve Deck; may place that card on top of opponent's Used Pile.”<ref name="cl-1240_68">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
